message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends in Canada for 2023. A long weekend typically includes a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break. (If you’re in a province with additional holidays, you might have extra long weekends.)

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **January 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | All provinces | Falls on Sunday; no extra day off. |
| **January 2** (Monday) | New Year’s Day (observed) | Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan | Observed because the actual holiday was on Sunday. |
| **January 16** (Monday) | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan | Long weekend (Jan 15–16). |
| **February 20** (Monday) | Family Day | Ontario | Long weekend (Feb 19–20). |
| **March 20** (Sunday) | Good Friday | All provinces | Good Friday is a statutory holiday; the following Monday (Mar 21) is a regular workday. |
| **March 21** (Monday) | Good Friday (observed) | New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | Observed because the actual holiday was on Sunday. |
| **April 7** (Monday) | Good Friday | All provinces | Long weekend (Apr 6–7). |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | All provinces | Long weekend (May 21–22). |
| **June 19** (Monday) | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut | Long weekend (Jun 18–19). |
| **July 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | All provinces | Falls on Saturday; no extra day off. |
| **July 3** (Monday) | Canada Day (observed) | Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan | Observed because the actual holiday was on Saturday. |
| **September 18** (Monday) | Labour Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Sep 17–18). |
| **October 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | All provinces | Long weekend (Oct 8–9). |
| **November 7** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Nov 6–7). |
| **December 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | All provinces | Long weekend (Dec 24–25). |
| **December 26** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day | All provinces | Regular workday; no long weekend. |

### How to use this in your app
1. **Create a holiday calendar**: Store each holiday’s date and province(s) in a database or JSON file.
2. **Generate long‑weekend alerts**: For each holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, flag the adjacent weekend days as “long weekend” in your UI.
3. **Add province‑specific logic**: Some provinces observe holidays on different dates (e.g., observed New Year’s Day in Alberta). Make sure your app respects those variations.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need holidays for other years or provinces!
